build_command: cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build
cli: malbolge run <file.mal> [--input <file>] [--max-steps N] [--json]; trace --output trace.jsonl; doctor; version
input_handling: file input via --input; exit codes 0/1/2; JSON report mode
compatibility: classic-malbolge (3^10); behavioral port-and-rewrite of Malbolge-Engine/src/vm.c (RAII, value-typed) - not a rename
known_issues: deliberate deviations from the C engine recorded in docs/REFERENCE_BEHAVIOR.md
